meta.name: ad-test-designer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "design an A/B test", "set up a creative/landing test", "run an incrementality test", or "is this result statistically and practically material?"; produces a hypothesis, variant matrix, sample-size/duration/power plan, and a documented effect/uncertainty read from own exported results. It applies only a precommitted owner-approved action rule; the statistical helper never chooses a business action. Not for producing variants — use ad-creative-builder; not for reading back one shipped change — use paid-measurement-loop. 广告AB测试设计/实验设计/显著性判定/增效测试

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并分析广告A/B测试，得出显著性结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要科学设计广告实验并判断结果是否显著
copy.tagline_en: Design and analyze A/B tests for ads with statistical rigor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to scientifically design ad experiments and determine if results are significant

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你设计广告A/B测试或增效测试，包括提出假设、制定变量矩阵、计算样本量和测试时长，以及分析测试结果并给出“推广”或“放弃”的建议。
howto.when: 当你要求“设计一个A/B测试”、“设置创意/落地页测试”、“运行增效测试”，或询问“这个结果在统计上显著吗”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个两个落地页版本的A/B测试。
say.note: 技能会输出测试假设、变量矩阵、样本量和时长计划。

say.text: 这是测试结果CSV，判断哪个版本胜出。
say.note: 技能会分析显著性并给出推广或放弃的建议。

howto.what_en: This skill helps you design A/B or incrementality tests for ads, including generating a hypothesis, variant matrix, sample size and duration plan, and analyzing results to give a promote or kill decision.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "design an A/B test", "set up a creative/landing test", "run an incrementality test", or "is this result statistically significant?".

say_en.text: Design an A/B test for two landing page hero variants.
say_en.note: The skill outputs hypothesis, variant matrix, sample size, and duration.

say_en.text: Here's my finished test results CSV. Is the winner significant?
say_en.note: The skill analyzes significance and gives a promote/kill decision.
